zh.title: 以色列引進KC-46A加油機將取代老舊波音707
zh.summary: 以色列引進全新KC-46A加油機以取代現役老舊波音707
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 31 日的報導，以色列的波音 707 空中加油機時代已接近尾聲。以色列全新的 KC-46A 「基甸」（Gideon）空中加油機將取代老化的 Re'ems 加油機。據報導，這款新型替代機型可多搭載大約 15% 的燃油，為其遠程空中戰力奠定現代化基礎。
在此之前，該地區近期亦有關於波音加油機的其他進展。美國國務院於 2026 年 8 月 20 日批准了一項對卡達的潛在軍售案，計畫出售最多四架波音 KC-46A 「飛馬」（Pegasus）空中加油機及相關設備，預估最高價值達 45 億美元。該筆卡達軍售案在達成最終協議前仍需經過美國國會審查，旨在提升卡達的空中加油能力。

en.title: Israel to Replace Aging Boeing 707 Tankers With New KC-46A Gideon Aircraft
en.summary: Israel's Boeing 707 tanker era nears end with replacement by new KC-46A Gideon aircraft.
body: According to aviation news outlet Simple Flying on August 31, 2026, Israel's Boeing 707 refueling tanker era is nearing its end. Israel's aging Re'ems tankers are planned to be replaced by the new KC-46A Gideon tankers, which reportedly haul approximately 15% more fuel and provide a modern foundation for its long-range airpower.

This transition follows other recent regional developments involving the Boeing tanker. On August 20, 2026, the US State Department approved a potential Foreign Military Sale to Qatar of up to four Boeing KC-46A Pegasus refueling aircraft and related equipment, estimated at up to $4.5 billion. The proposed sale, which requires US congressional review before a final agreement can be reached, aims to improve Qatar's aerial refueling capability.
